name: Fort Aimaru
title: Fort Aimaru
summary: An abandoned Sho fort, first overrun by drudges and later taken by dark mosswarts who guard a runed chest (acpedia). In the kit it is a walled compound at z 6 on the grassland, 200 m from the sea. Two 31 m five-storey spire towers flank a long, low stone hall whose roof carries a palisade of plank stakes and wooden spires. Single-storey stone ranges stand to the south. The Archmage's tower and a Life Stone stand 230 m north-west.

site.name: Fort Aimaru
site.notes: The gazetteer entry fort-aimaru is only a map @tele and there is no exact outdoor teleport at the fort (the nearest, Life Stone near Hebian-to, is 239 m away by the Archmage's tower); derived @teleloc on open grass 40 m north of the fort's central hall (ground z 3.7, nearest tree 14.9 m).

shots.standingOrder: Cross the fort from west to east 44 m up with the low sun at your back, holding the twin spire towers and the hall in frame through the vertical toward the sea; stay 12 m above both spires.
shots.notes: Pass-over at 44 m above the fort with the gimbal held on it through the vertical. The flight runs west to east with the low sun (0.74) behind it, so the two 31 m spire towers and the palisaded hall below are lit. They slide under the lens and the grassland and the sea open ahead. The path clears both spires by 13 m. shots.standingOrder: Fly south between the two spire towers 16 m above the hall roof and its palisade, slowing in the gap, then glide over the inner court; keep 8 m from each tower wall.
shots.notes: Fly-through on the north-south axis, between the twin spire towers and 16 m above the roof of the central hall with its wooden stakes. The drone slows in the 29 m gap and glides on over the inner court and the south ranges. The low western sun comes from the right and lights the east tower's inner face. The gap is crossed at t 5.0. The flight keeps 14.5 m from each tower wall and 9 m from the roof props.
